item.title: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport (KCLE) - JSD Scenery
item.description: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport (KCLE) is a significant commercial airport in the northeastern United States, developed by JSD Scenery in Version 2.0 for X-Plane 12. This scenery provides a detailed representation of the airport and its surroundings.
item.author: XoL Team

item.title: Denver International Airport (KDEN) - X-Codr Designs
item.description: Denver International Airport (KDEN) is one of the largest and most modern airports in the USA, developed by X-Codr Designs in Version 2.2 for X-Plane 12. This scenery provides a detailed representation of the airport and its surroundings.
item.author: XoL Team

item.title: Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX) - X-Plane.org
item.description: Los Angeles International Airport (KLAX) is one of the largest and busiest airports in the world, developed by X-Plane.org in HD version for X-Plane 12. This scenery provides a detailed representation of the airport and its surroundings.
item.author: XoL Team
